sentences: Sessions on the Delta terminal use the default channel parameters until a SessionUpdate message is received.
The control channel CCH1 is opened during session set-up.
The terminal never closes CCH1 while a session is active.
The marketing name of the product is Delta One.

requirements.text: The terminal shall use the default channel parameters until a SessionUpdate message is received.
The terminal shall open the control channel CCH1 during session set-up.
The terminal shall not close CCH1 while a session is active.
